drafts.rationale: EV-O-A05 and EV-O-A01 both specify a capped number of executions per job so a job that cannot succeed does not run forever.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B05 and EV-O-B01 both require a wait after a failed execution before the job is delivered again.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C05 and EV-O-C01 bound how long an execution may run and treat reaching that limit as a failed attempt.
drafts.subject: Orion execution attempt

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D05 and EV-O-D01 require that further deliveries of an already active job id be ignored without changing the active job.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E05 and EV-O-E01 require Orion to remember each producer idempotency key for a bounded time after first seen, then treat a later same key as new.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency key

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F05 and EV-O-F01 grant a time-limited lease when a job is delivered to a worker and make the job available to others if the lease expires unrestored.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G05 and EV-O-G01 allow a progressing worker to renew its lease and require each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H05 and EV-O-H01 stop future execution attempts after cancel while leaving an already running attempt to finish, fail, or time out.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I05 and EV-O-I01 require an automatic move to the dead-letter queue after the last unsuccessful attempt, with no further execution unless resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J05 and EV-O-J01 require an operator escalation when three dead-letter events for one tenant fall within a one-hour window measured from the first event.
drafts.subject: Orion dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K05 and EV-O-K01 guarantee FIFO execution only among jobs in the same queue partition and make no ordering promise across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L05 and EV-O-L01 require audit events of job state transitions to be kept for a bounded period after recording and allow deletion afterward.
drafts.subject: Orion audit event

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 require a job to be executed at most three times in total, with the first execution counting as one of the three and no further execution after a third unsuccessful attempt.
EV-O-A03, EV-O-A04, and EV-O-A05 replace the three-total cap with one initial execution plus up to three retries, and EV-O-A04 states the job is not executed a fifth time.

value.text: Each job begins with one initial execution; if that does not succeed the worker may perform up to three retry executions, and no further execution may be started after the third retry ends without success.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01 through EV-O-B04 require a wait of exactly five seconds before every retry, measured from the end of the failed attempt, and forbid changing that wait by attempt number.
EV-O-B05 requires a two-second wait before the first retry, doubling before each later retry, with a thirty-second cap.

value.text: Wait two seconds before the first retry, then double the wait before each later retry, never exceeding thirty seconds.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C01 sets a thirty-second timeout; EV-O-C02 through EV-O-C05 restate the same bound as half a minute, and the examples mark failure at 30 seconds.
EV-O-C02 through EV-O-C05 require stopping an execution at the time limit and recording that stop as a failed attempt.

value.text: When the time limit is reached the execution must be stopped and recorded as a failed attempt.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D01 through EV-O-D05 require ignoring duplicate deliveries of an active job id without changing that job's state.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, any further delivery carrying the same job id must be ignored and must not change the state of the active job.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01 through EV-O-E05 require each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen.
EV-O-E01 through EV-O-E05 state that once the retention period ends the key may be forgotten and a later same-key delivery is treated as new.

value.text: After the retention period the key may be forgotten and a later delivery with the same key is treated as new.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F01 through EV-O-F05 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from the moment the job is delivered to the worker.

drafts.predicate: effect of expiry without renewal or release
drafts.rationale: EV-O-F01 through EV-O-F05 require that an expired unrewewed and unreleased lease makes the job available to other workers.

value.text: When the lease expires without renewal or release, the job must become available to other workers.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G01 through EV-O-G05 allow a worker to renew its lease every thirty seconds while work on the job is progressing.
EV-O-G01 through EV-O-G05 require each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment, as in the sixty-second examples.

value.text: A renewal must extend the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 through EV-O-H05 forbid starting any further execution attempt after cancellation.

value.text: After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt of that job may be started.

drafts.predicate: effect on an already running attempt
drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 through EV-O-H05 require a running attempt to continue to completion, failure, or timeout despite cancellation.

value.text: Cancellation must not interrupt an execution attempt that is already running; that attempt runs to its own completion, failure or timeout.

drafts.predicate: automatic placement after final unsuccessful attempt
drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01 through EV-O-I05 require Orion to move the job to the dead-letter queue automatically after the last unsuccessful attempt, without operator involvement.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01 through EV-O-I05 forbid executing a dead-lettered job again unless it is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: A job in the dead-letter queue must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J01 through EV-O-J05 require an operator escalation at three same-tenant dead-letter events within one hour counted from the first event.

value.text: When three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events, Orion must raise an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K01 through EV-O-K05 guarantee FIFO only within a queue partition and make no ordering promise across partitions.

value.text: First-in-first-out execution order must be guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee is made between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 through EV-O-L05 require audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded.
EV-O-L01 through EV-O-L05 allow an audit event to be deleted after thirty days.

value.text: After thirty days an audit event may be deleted.
